title: Procurement Of Advanced Diagnostic Tool For Predictive Maintenance Of Various Transmission Lines
scope_summary: Tender for the procurement of an advanced diagnostic tool for predictive maintenance of transmission lines under Kumaon Zone, Haldwani and Garhwal Zone, Roorkee. The system is expected to provide real-time equipment health monitoring, alerts, analytics, and support predictive maintenance with requisite IT/OT cybersecurity.

title: Facility Management Services - Lumpsum Based - Asset Management Contract For Powergrid, M P Hall And E- Tower Guest House At Sector -43, Gurugram, Haryana
